sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Jiangsu Mactape Industrial Products Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in material supply of double-sided tape, self-adhesive labels, reflective film, and advertising film with manufacturing and after-sales service capabilities.

Industry: Materials & Manufacturing · HQ: Jiangsu, China · Size: not published · Products: Reflective Films, Label Materials, Fleet Graphics, Adhesive Tapes, Graphic Films, Reflective Sheeting

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: MAC Labels scores 63 of 100 (tier B) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (24/30), application fit (24/25) and pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for company size and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, weatherability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (56% similar on films, printing, graphic, vinyl); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (50% similar on films, vinyl, fleet, graphics); ORAFOL Europe (47% similar on films, graphic, printing, self-adhesive). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
